description: List products with filters and pagination. Charges are NOT included by default — pass kind="charge" to list them (each row then carries `charge_state` with the current cycle, days late and today's total) or kind="all" for both. Requires scope `merchant_read`.

kind.description: Row kind. The API DEFAULTS to `product`, so charges are invisible unless you ask: pass `charge` to list charges (each row then carries `charge_state`) or `all` for both.

q.description: Substring search over slug, name and description.

name: list_products

charge_state.description: Derived payable state — charge rows only. Without it you cannot tell an overdue rent from one that is not due yet.

capped.description: true = base + late fees exceeded the per-transaction cap and was clamped.

cycle_due_date.description: Due date of the current — oldest unpaid — cycle.

in_flight.description: A paid Pix for this charge is still settling.

open_past_due_cycles.description: More than 1 means cycles piled up.

settled.description: true = a one-time charge that is fully paid; the other fields are then absent.

total_today_cents.description: What a QR created right now would charge.

title: List products
